title: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning: AI-Driven Summarisation for Local Plan Consultations
summary: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning reports that the PlanAI language model cut a consultation-summary task from 18.5 officer hours to 16 minutes while officers still read every response.
account: Greater Cambridge Shared Planning reports that a large language model summarizes consultation comments while planning officers still read every submission. The tool was used in three supplementary-planning-document consultations in winter 2024–25. A summary task reportedly fell from 18.5 officer hours to 16 minutes of model run time. The Local Government Association case study also reports savings of over 60% without defining that calculation. The developers report that in 2025 a planner and PlanAI processed the same 320 submissions in parallel. They report that a later quality check found no discernible difference between the summaries. In February 2026 UKAuthority reported that the tool was being tested in five more planning authorities.
purpose: Summarize planning-consultation representations and identify themes while retaining officer review.
system: Bespoke planning-consultation LLM with the Opus Consult platform
developer: University of Liverpool (LLM); JDi Solutions (Opus Consult platform)

ratings.reason: The completed summary task and soft launch in three consultations support time savings.
Less summary-writing work frees officers for analysis and engagement. This is a task-time benefit.
Improved public participation is intended. Its extent is unknown.

ai_role.statement: The developers ran the same three consultations through a planner and through PlanAI and timed the summary step that the model performed. Officers still downloaded and read every submission. The developers ran the quality check that found no discernible difference, and they have not published its method.
